metaDescription: DeckStain.ca won London's 2026 award for Deck & Fence Staining. See how the photo-quote process, READY Seal stain and 4.9-star rating stack up.
summary: DeckStain.ca is a deck and fence staining specialist serving London, Ontario, using a photo-based quoting process to price jobs quickly and accurately. The company has completed more than 500 projects using a premium oil-based stain designed to resist peeling through Ontario winters.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: DeckStain.ca focuses on deck and fence staining, cleaning, sealing, restoration and refinishing rather than building or repairing structures. The company applies READY Seal, an oil-based stain available in eight colours, chosen for a deep-penetrating, no-peel finish on outdoor wood. That narrow focus has produced an eight-year track record and more than 500 completed projects across the region.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Homeowners submit a photo of their deck or fence and receive a firm quote within two business days, rather than waiting for an in-person estimate to be scheduled. The company backs every job with a 100 percent satisfaction guarantee, and the final invoice is expected to match the quote given from the photo. This process suits homeowners who want a fast answer without a site visit just for pricing.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: Reviewers describe the photo-quote process as quick and accurate, with the final charge matching what was quoted upfront. One customer noted that deck staining is an annual chore in Canada and was glad to have a reliable company handle it each year. DeckStain.ca holds a 4.9-star rating across the areas it serves.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: DeckStain.ca is based in London and describes its work as covering more than 40 cities across Southwestern Ontario. Homeowners outside the immediate London area should confirm current coverage of their specific address before requesting a photo quote.

strengths: Uses READY Seal oil-based stain, chosen for a deep-penetrating, no-peel finish in eight colours.
Photo-based quoting delivers a firm price within two business days without an in-person estimate visit.
More than 500 completed projects and an eight-year track record in deck and fence staining.
Backed by a 100 percent satisfaction guarantee and a 4.9-star regional rating.
considerations: Specializes only in staining, cleaning, sealing and restoration, not deck or fence construction or repair.
Quoting is photo-based, so unusual site conditions may need a follow-up before the price is finalized.
Exterior staining is seasonal work, so booking is tightest through spring and fall.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting a fast, photo-based staining quote
Anyone refinishing an aging deck or fence before it peels
Owners who prefer an oil-based, no-peel finish over water-based stain
Repeat annual maintenance staining in London and area
questionsToAsk: Which READY Seal colour and sheen would you recommend for my wood type and sun exposure?
Does the quoted price include cleaning and any minor wood repair before staining?
How long should I wait between washing the deck and applying the stain?
What does the satisfaction guarantee cover if the finish doesn't hold up as expected?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means DeckStain.ca was selected as the top-reviewed business in its category and city through an independent editorial review of public information, service scope and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected or listed.

faq.q: Does DeckStain.ca build or repair decks?
faq.a: No. The company's listed services are staining, cleaning, sealing, restoration and refinishing rather than construction, so homeowners needing new framing or board replacement should confirm scope separately before booking.

faq.q: How does the photo-quote process work?
faq.a: Homeowners submit a photo of the deck or fence and receive a price within two business days, with the final invoice matching the quoted amount according to reviewers.

faq.q: What stain product do they use?
faq.a: DeckStain.ca applies READY Seal, an oil-based stain offered in eight colours, chosen for a deep-penetrating finish that resists peeling compared with water-based alternatives.
